data.long_meaning: The name Priyanjali means the offering of love. In Hinduism, the name is given to a girl as a symbol of love, happiness, and gentleness. The name Priyanjali carries the meaning “Offering of Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Priyanjali usually hope their child will grow to embody offering of love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Priyanjali represents the spirit of offering love and joy to others.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Priyanjali total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
